Technical & price structure: In plain terms: at EGP 6.43 the market pays about half of what the marked land bank and the signed partnership contracts are worth (~EGP 8.30). The bet is that those contracts — Madinet Masr, G Developments, Middle East — pay on schedule under a 72% state owner.
Monte Carlo — where could the price go?: Below 5.00 the market would be paying less than even the "contracts never pay" case — the point where we'd rebuild the study.

One Monte Carlo model, 50,000 paths, driven by 16 forces: the central-bank rate, the EGP/USD rate, inflation, foreign money flows, oil, east-Cairo absorption, build-cost, plus nine event forces — H1 results, new partnership awards, a state stake-sale step, land auctions, dividends, regional risk, a devaluation step, a title/NUCA dispute and partner slippage. Full mechanics in the methodology .
FAQ: What is the fair-value range for Heliopolis Housing (HELI)? — testahil publishes a probability distribution of where HELI could trade over the next 1–3 months — the simulated 5th–95th percentile range and the central 50% — not a single price target or a buy/sell call. The full study and open model show the methodology. This is educational analysis, not investment advice.

How is the HELI valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a sum-of-the-parts / RNAV build on the New Heliopolis land bank and its signed partnership contracts — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.

Does testahil recommend buying or selling HELI? — No. testahil never issues buy, sell, or hold recommendations. It publishes fair-value ranges and probability distributions as educational material, and grades its own forecasts publicly when they resolve.
Is the Heliopolis Housing model free to download? — Yes. The full HELI valuation study (Word/PDF) and the open Excel model are free to download, with every assumption editable.
